### Changed
- **Automation health now catches senders with no connected inbox.** A sequence
  can only send from a user who holds a paid Sales or Service seat *and* has
  connected a personal inbox. The scan already flagged deactivated senders; it now
  also flags a live sender whose inbox is not connected, and -- for workflows that
  send as the contact owner -- any owner who holds a seat but has no connected
  inbox, so their enrolled contacts silently fail to send. These are named in the
  report so you can connect an inbox or reassign the sender. Read for free from the
  user data the scan already fetches; no new permissions.
